assignments.name: documents
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const rawRoot = $json; const root = Array.isArray(rawRoot) && rawRoot.length && typeof rawRoot[0] === 'object' ? rawRoot[0] : (rawRoot || {}); const p = root.payload && typeof root.payload === 'object' ? root.payload : root; if (Array.isArray(p.documents) && p.documents.length) return p.documents; const asDocRows = (arr) => (Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : []).filter((x) => x && typeof x === 'object' && String(x.document_id || '').trim()); const rawContent = p.content; const c = Array.isArray(rawContent) ? rawContent : (rawContent && typeof rawContent === 'object' ? [rawContent] : []); const out = []; for (const part of c) { if (!part || typeof part !== 'object') continue; if (Array.isArray(part.documents)) { out.push(...part.documents); continue; } if (part.type === 'text' && part.text != null) { if (Array.isArray(part.text)) { out.push(...part.text); continue; } if (part.text && typeof part.text === 'object' && !Array.isArray(part.text)) { out.push(part.text); continue; } if (typeof part.text === 'string') { let t = part.text.trim(); if (t.startsWith('```')) t = t.replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*```\s*$/, '').trim(); try { const parsed = JSON.parse(t); if (Array.isArray(parsed)) out.push(...parsed); else if (parsed && Array.isArray(parsed.documents)) out.push(...parsed.documents); else if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && String(parsed.document_id || '').trim()) out.push(parsed); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ } } continue; } if (String(part.document_id || '').trim()) out.push(part); } const rows = asDocRows(out); if (rows.length) return rows; return asDocRows(c); })() }}

parameters.query:
SELECT input1.id, input1.updatedDate, input1.name, input1.url, input1.uploader
FROM input1
LEFT JOIN input2 ON input1.id = input2.documentId
WHERE input2.documentId IS NULL
   OR input2.lastProcessedDate IS NULL
   OR input2.lastProcessedDate = ''
   OR input1.updatedDate > input2.lastProcessedDate
